svg.aria-label: Claude Code answering a question with the thehub MCP server
svg.text: claude — thehub MCP server
> Which Finnish companies founded after 2018 have 11–50 employees?
⏺ thehub · search_companies(country="FI", employees="11-50", founded_after=2018,
limit=50)
⎿ {"total": 17, "companies": [AIContentfy, Bind, Cerecaptio, Clausal, …]}
⏺ thehub.io lists 17 Finnish companies founded after 2018 with 11–50 employees. The
list only covers IT and software companies that aren't currently raising funding.
- AIContentfy (2023, bootstrapping): AI-generated SEO content
- Bind (2025, seed): AI contract drafting and negotiation
- Cerecaptio (2020, bootstrapping): recruitment partner for high-growth companies
- Clausal (2025, Series A): navigation for uncrewed systems when satellite
positioning (GNSS) is jammed or unavailable
- eMabler (2019, Series A): open platform for running EV charging businesses
- FinanceKey (2021, seed): real-time treasury and cash-management platform
- Flowrite (2020, seed): AI writing tool for emails and messages
- Front AI (2019, seed): AI customer-service bots; also in Denmark and Sweden
- Linear (2019, stage not listed): software for real estate agents
- Marvel Consulting (2019, bootstrapping): software consultancy
- Meltlake (2020, bootstrapping): Microsoft specialist consultancy
- Metroc (2019, seed): AI market-data platform for construction and real estate
- Mobal.io (2020, seed): digital tools for small businesses; also in Sweden
- Noice (2020, pre-seed): games and social platform, in stealth
- PK Cloud (2021, bootstrapping): IT services and staffing
- Skyfora (2019, seed): lightweight weather sondes and AI weather forecasts
- Workfellow (2020, Series A): automating repetitive knowledge work
AI is the common thread, and Clausal stands out: founded in 2025, it has already
raised a Series A and reached 11–50 employees.
